name: FixTL
description: Adds /fixtl — clears the vanilla Entity.Teleporting flag when it gets stuck true on a player entity. Vanilla BlockEntityTeleporterBase.HandleTeleportingServer silently skips any entity with this flag set (continue;), which manifests as 'translocator particles play but no teleport.' Flag is only cleared inside the chunk-load OnLoaded callback of TeleportToDouble, so if that callback never resolves, the flag leaks until relog.
